role: Visual Target Director / independent catalog reviewer
reviewScope: bottoms-1 through bottoms-12 current canonical exact hashes; prior tops exact-hash decisions preserved

originalReferencePixels.note: Reviews use the frozen visual contracts plus actual running-game pixels; generated promotional collages are not reference evidence and pixel-identical parity is not claimed.

renderEvidence.continuity: Legacy Tops hashes reviewed below remain unchanged; versioned tops-7-w09-v2 and tops-8-w09-v2 are newer and not covered by this artifact.
Git compare from artifact runtime head through sourceHead contains no bottoms asset changes; exact hashes are recorded below.

familyFindings.tops: Legacy Tops are recognizable but consistently flat, front-facing vector garments with weak material volume and insufficient tier progression.
familyFindings.bottoms: Bottoms are item-readable but repeat flat frontal vector silhouettes with drawn-on seams, pockets, pleats and motifs; Tier 4-5 lacks the required material/spectacle jump.

items.name: Hoodie
items.reason: Flat front-facing garment with weak fabric volume/folds/material response; rebuild as dimensional toy-fashion while retaining simple starter identity.

items.name: Zip Hoodie
items.reason: Readable identity, but flat frontal icon; add hood/body separation, zipper hardware, folds and three-quarter lighting.

items.name: Varsity Tee
items.reason: Readable tee/motif but sparse and two-dimensional; add body volume, collar/sleeve construction and material shading.

items.name: Bow Cardigan
items.reason: Knit, buttons, bow and cuffs read as flat shapes; needs soft-material depth, layered bow construction and dimensional lighting.

items.name: Crewneck
items.reason: Little construction/material character; add sweatshirt volume, ribbing/folds and richer galaxy material response.

items.name: Gamer Jacket
items.reason: Recognizable gamer cues but flat layering/hardware/materials; add dimensional collar, panels, seams and restrained luminous tech accents.

items.name: Colorblock Hoodie
items.reason: Colorblocking differs, but silhouette remains flat/frontal; needs hood/body dimensionality, seams/folds, material variation and collectible framing.

items.name: Puffer Vest
items.reason: Puffer sections do not convincingly read lofted/quilted; increase cushion volume, panel light/shadow, zipper/opening construction and art detail.

items.name: Art Smock
items.reason: Paint/smock identity is present but garment/tool layering and fabric depth are not premium.

items.name: Star Bomber
items.reason: Tier 4 lacks material richness/spectacle; needs bomber volume, ribbing, reflective material, hardware and controlled neon rim.

items.name: Cloud Jacket
items.reason: Cloud motif is readable, but Tier-4 construction/plush depth and lighting are insufficient; add volume, seams/hardware and candy-luxe material response.

items.name: Star Coat
items.reason: Highest tier lacks luxe construction/materials/hero lighting; needs layered lapels/trim and spectacular but readable star detail.

items.name: Jeans
items.reason: Readable starter jeans but flat symmetric cutout with no convincing denim grain, seam/pocket thickness, folds or leg volume.

items.name: Joggers
items.reason: Readable identity but lacks gathered waistband/cuffs, fleece/knit response, pocket depth and drape.

items.name: Cargo Pants
items.reason: Cargo pockets are flat rectangles with no flap/hardware/seam/crease volume or believable fabric lighting.

items.name: Pleat Skirt
items.reason: Pleats are mostly drawn lines on a flat trapezoid; needs layered pleat depth, waistband thickness, hem volume and directional material lighting.

items.name: Overalls
items.reason: Bib/straps establish identity but remain paper-flat; add buckle/button hardware, overlapping construction, fabric texture and folds.

items.name: Star Leggings
items.reason: Sticker-like stars on a flat template; needs stretch-fabric contour/sheen, waistband depth, leg curvature and controlled luxe highlights.

items.name: Sport Shorts
items.reason: Flat/icon-like waistband and leg openings; needs elastic/drawcord construction, technical fabric, folds and dimensional rim light.

items.name: Wide-Leg Pants
items.reason: Broad flat pink shape has little drape, waistband/pleat construction, side volume or fabric response.

items.name: Patch Jeans
items.reason: Patches/stitches sit on a flat jeans silhouette; needs denim volume, seam depth and physically layered stitched patches.

items.name: Utility Skirt
items.reason: Tier 4 still reads as flat trapezoid with printed pockets; needs fabric thickness, layered flaps/hardware, seams, hem depth and premium cloud cues.

items.name: Glitter Cargo
items.reason: Glitter is dots/squares over flat cargo form; needs reflective textile response, layered pockets/hardware, folds and premium lighting.

items.name: Star Trousers
items.reason: Tier 5 remains flat/front-facing; needs tailored folds/leg volume, metallic trim, layered star embroidery/gems and controlled hero lighting.
